summary: Entity links no longer slow a long chat while an answer streams: finished messages are not read or mounted again per chunk, and markdownComponents keep their identity.
howTo: Nothing to do. What an app can notice (the CHANGELOG lists every difference): a custom components.MentionChip in a finished message is no longer unmounted and mounted again per chunk; useChatEntityLinks() and its markdownComponents keep their identity; in text parts rendered without Markdown (EntityText) a matcher chip follows a changed hit, new matchers apply to finished messages, and resolveAmbiguous is called less often. Apps that change messages in place (not the AI SDK) should replace a changed output, input or result object rather than mutate it.
